summary: Spatially renders audio from source channels using listener/source 3D transforms and Steam Audio modes. Outputs channel counts based on the selected output format, such as binaural, stereo, surround, or ambisonics.
key_concepts: Audio Render CHOP uses Steam Audio SDK spatial rendering from listener and source transforms.
The source audio sample rate must be 44100 or 48000 Hz.
Simple Positional mode supports a mono source, while Simulation mode supports multiple sources and environmental simulation.
Output Format determines the number and meaning of output channels, including binaural, stereo, surround, custom, ambisonics, and direct-effect formats.
Custom speaker output uses a Mapping Table DAT with x, y, and z speaker-position columns.

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Simple positional or simulation rendering mode

key_params.name: outputformat
key_params.note: Binaural, stereo, surround, custom, ambisonics, or direct output

key_params.name: attenuation
key_params.note: Attenuate source audio by source/listener distance

key_params.name: mappingtable
key_params.note: Speaker-position table for custom output format

key_params.name: listenerobject
key_params.note: 3D component used as the listener transform

key_params.name: source0object
key_params.note: 3D component used as the first source transform

key_params.name: mesh
key_params.note: Simulation mesh source for occlusion/reflection workflows

common_gotchas: Input audio must use a supported sample rate, commonly 44100 or 48000 Hz.
Apple Silicon support starts with TouchDesigner build 2022.33910.
Simulation and reflection workflows require valid meshes and may need explicit baking before the result is meaningful.
